answers: Not much. Branch deletion frees close to 0 space, since branch files are tiny and commits stay in .git/objects until reflog expires and git gc runs.
/srv/app/uploads/tmp is the biggest target, up to 31G. Docker is the largest item at 48G, but its gain is unknown until docker system df is run.

SSH host, user, and sudo access (or pasted command output), rules for what writes to uploads/tmp, confirmation no file is the only copy, an age limit, Docker rollback needs, branches to keep, and an explicit go for Phase 2.
